newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran hangs two brothers convicted of murder.
newsitem.headline: Iran hangs two brothers convicted of murder.

text.p: Iran executed two brothers convicted of killing four of their relatives, the Kayhan newspaper reported on Saturday.

It said the brothers were hanged on Friday in Tehran's Qasr prison for killing two women and their two children in 1995 after a money robbery. The family relationship was not made clear in the report.
In a separate report, the Iran Daily said a 55-year-old Iranian stabbed his wife and one of his sons to death and injured another two of his children and his father-in-law.
It gave no details on the motive but said police was searching for the father.
